voice_style.oona: Warm, playful old ghost grandmother telling a bedtime story. Smiling, slightly whispery, sing-song, bright on exclamations. Never cackles, never spooky. Quick delivery: each line fits in about 2 seconds.
voice_style.elevenlabs: A gentle, older female storyteller voice. Stability ~40%, Similarity ~75%, Style ~30%, Speed 1.05-1.1.
voice_style.openai_tts: gpt-4o-mini-tts with voice 'fable' or 'sage' (or 'marin'/'cedar'), the Oona prompt as instructions. Disclose the AI voice on the parent sign.
voice_style.smudge: Not a separate actor: record Smudge's line with Oona's voice; the builder pitches it up 5 semitones at 1.15x speed (fx: smudge).

clips.notes: Oona sleeps/peeks; Smudge flutters to the (device-drawn) Moon, munches, flies off.
After the Moon is full: lit pumpkins; Smudge the Official Trickster visits.
The device draws the beam of crystal-coloured light into the lantern.
6 colour variants awaken_1..awaken_6 (crystal tinted with color.N_hex). The device adds rays/glow + the meter.
One visual for every rank; the device draws the crystal, rank aura, meter and rank name.
The device draws the button prompt, meter fill and sparkles.
Gag 1 The Sneeze. The device sprinkles polka dots in the crystal colour.
Gag 2 The Bubble Burp (the bubble floats down into the crystal).
Gag 3 Pumpkin Head (the device adds a sparkle poof at 0.6 s).
A little silver moon rises from the lantern and joins the big Moon.
The Witch's Hat spins up out of the lantern.
Variant 2: the hat lands on Oona, who winks.
The rays turn slowly; the Wishing Star rises and grows (no strobe).
A star-wisp drifts from the lantern to the kid.
The device adds confetti in the six crystal colours + the big counter.
The device orbits small crystals in the group's colours.
The finale: Smudge dazzled, then sorry; the pumpkins light up.

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Crystal on the stone! Wake me up!
voice.caption: CRYSTAL HERE
voice.delivery: sleepy murmur that brightens on 'Wake me up'; gentle, not loud

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: No crystal? Press the big button!
voice.caption: OR PRESS
voice.delivery: friendly and clear, a touch slower on 'big button'

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Smudge nibbled my Moon! Can you help?
voice.caption: HELP OONA!
voice.delivery: playfully worried, giggly underneath, never scared

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Every crystal makes the Moon brighter!
voice.caption: FILL THE MOON
voice.delivery: warm storyteller, hopeful lift at the end

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Shh... I hear crystals coming...
voice.caption: SHHH...

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Crystals on the stone! Fill the Moon!
voice.caption: CRYSTAL HERE
voice.delivery: bright inviting call across the porch, sing-song

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Set your crystal here! I'm awake... almost!
voice.caption: SET IT DOWN
voice.delivery: yawny and cozy, little giggle on 'almost'

voice.speaker: Smudge
voice.text: Nom nom! Marshmallow moonlight! Hee hee!
voice.caption: NOM NOM!
voice.delivery: Smudge: Oona's take pitched up 5 semitones and 1.15x, mouth-full munchy giggle, tiny and silly

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: A brand-new crystal! It's waking up!
voice.caption: NEW CRYSTAL!
voice.delivery: gasp of wonder, bright and quick

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Ooh! Hello, little sleepy crystal!
voice.caption: HELLO!
voice.delivery: tender delight, like greeting a baby bird

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Twilight violet! The crystal of dreamers!
voice.caption: TWILIGHT
voice.delivery: proud announcement: land the colour name, then dreamy and warm (variant 1 = colour ID 1, violet)

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Ember orange! The crystal of brave hearts!
voice.caption: EMBER
voice.delivery: proud announcement, extra spark on 'brave hearts' (colour ID 2, orange)

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Frost blue! The coolest crystal of all!
voice.caption: FROST
voice.delivery: proud, playful wink on 'coolest' (colour ID 3, ice blue)

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Potion green! The crystal of clever tricksters!
voice.caption: POTION
voice.delivery: proud, sly-fun on 'clever tricksters' (colour ID 4, green)

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Pixie pink! The crystal of best friends!
voice.caption: PIXIE

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Ghostlight! It can see hidden things!
voice.caption: GHOSTLIGHT
voice.delivery: proud then a mysterious hush on 'hidden things' (colour ID 6, clear)

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: You're a Spark! Welcome, Lightkeeper!
voice.caption: SPARK!

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Spark! Look, two lights already!
voice.caption: SPARK!

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: You came back! Hello, Apprentice!
voice.caption: APPRENTICE

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Your crystal remembers! Welcome, Apprentice!
voice.caption: APPRENTICE

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Lamplighter! Now you light the way!
voice.caption: LAMPLIGHTER

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Welcome back, Lamplighter! So bright!
voice.caption: LAMPLIGHTER

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: A real Wizard! Your starlight sparkles!
voice.caption: WIZARD

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Welcome back, Wizard! Cast your light!
voice.caption: WIZARD

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Starcatcher! Even the stars wave hello!
voice.caption: STARCATCHER

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Welcome back, Starcatcher! The stars remember!
voice.caption: STARCATCHER

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Moon Rider! Climb aboard my Moon!
voice.caption: MOON RIDER

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: My Moon Rider is back! Wheee!
voice.caption: MOON RIDER

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Moon Guardian! The Moon bows to you!
voice.caption: MOON GUARDIAN

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Welcome home, Moon Guardian!
voice.caption: MOON GUARDIAN
voice.delivery: deeply warm, like hugging an old friend

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Press the button! Fill the Moon!
voice.caption: PRESS!

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Quick, press! Send your light up!
voice.caption: PRESS!

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Bless you, Smudge! Candy's still yours!
voice.caption: SMUDGED!
voice.delivery: giggling through it, reassuring on 'Candy's still yours' (gag 1: The Sneeze)

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: He burped you a bubble! Candy anyway!
voice.caption: SMUDGED!
voice.delivery: amused disbelief, then cheerful (gag 2: The Bubble Burp)

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Pumpkin on my head?! Candy's still yours!
voice.caption: SMUDGED!
voice.delivery: muffled-silly surprise, then laughing (gag 3: Pumpkin Head)

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Silver Moon! Your crystal shines so bright!
voice.caption: SILVER MOON

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Silver Moon! The Moon says thank you!
voice.caption: SILVER MOON

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Ooh! A Witch's Hat! So rare!
voice.caption: WITCH'S HAT!

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Witch's Hat magic! Hardly anyone finds it!
voice.caption: WITCH'S HAT!

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: The Wishing Star! Make a wish!
voice.caption: WISHING STAR!
voice.delivery: awed hush rising to joy; soft magical whisper on 'Make a wish'

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Wishing Star! The rarest light of all!
voice.caption: WISHING STAR!

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Silver circle! Take one treat!
voice.caption: SILVER CIRCLE
voice.delivery: clear and friendly, crisp on 'Silver circle'

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Red triangle! Take one treat!
voice.caption: RED TRIANGLE

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Gold star! The grown-up has it!
voice.caption: GOLD STAR

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Shh! Your crystal already glows tonight!
voice.caption: ALREADY GLOWING

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Your crystal already holds tonight's light!
voice.caption: ALREADY GLOWING

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: A star-wisp for you! Happy Halloween!
voice.caption: STAR-WISP!

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Here's a star-wisp! You helped the Moon!
voice.caption: STAR-WISP!

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Set it down again! Sleepy crystal.
voice.caption: TRY AGAIN
voice.delivery: soft and patient, a little yawn in it

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Try again! Your crystal is yawning.
voice.caption: TRY AGAIN

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Bring it back next Halloween!
voice.caption: SEE YOU 2027

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: See you next Halloween, Lightkeeper!
voice.caption: SEE YOU 2027

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Last year: a silly trick! Hee hee!
voice.caption: LAST YEAR

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Last year, your crystal found a Silver Moon!
voice.caption: LAST YEAR

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Last year, you found the Witch's Hat!
voice.caption: LAST YEAR

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Last year, you caught the Wishing Star!
voice.caption: LAST YEAR

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Silver circle! Smudge got you!
voice.caption: SMUDGED!
voice.delivery: fast, giggly, bowl words crisp (rush mode)

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Silver circle! Silver Moon!
voice.caption: SILVER MOON

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Red triangle! Witch's Hat!
voice.caption: WITCH'S HAT!

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Gold star! Wishing Star!
voice.caption: WISHING STAR!

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Every Halloween, I light the Moon, so everyone finds their way home.
voice.caption: OONA'S MOON

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: But this year I overslept... and Smudge nibbled it like a cookie!
voice.caption: UH-OH, SMUDGE!

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Long ago, the Moon laughed so hard that sparkles fell as crystals.
voice.caption: MOONSHARDS

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: And now YOU carry them. Each crystal holds its very own light.
voice.caption: YOUR LIGHT
voice.delivery: leaning in, emphasis on YOU, tender

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Set your crystal on the stone, and its light flies up to the Moon!
voice.caption: CRYSTAL HERE

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Fill the Moon tonight, Lightkeepers... and see what happens to Smudge!
voice.caption: FILL THE MOON
voice.delivery: rallying, then a mischievous teasing whisper

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Another hundred crystals! Hooray, Lightkeepers!
voice.caption: HOORAY!

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: A hundred more crystals! The Moon is dancing!
voice.caption: HOORAY!

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: The Moon is full! You did it!
voice.caption: MOON SAVED!
voice.delivery: overjoyed triumph, biggest moment of the night, still warm not shouty

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Silly Smudge... you're my Official Trickster now!
voice.caption: OFFICIAL TRICKSTER
voice.delivery: fond forgiving chuckle, then proud announcement

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: A crystal circle! The Moon loves friends!
voice.caption: CRYSTAL CIRCLE!

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Psst, Guardian... Smudge wants your autograph!
voice.caption: SHH... SECRET
voice.delivery: close secret whisper, barely holding a giggle

voice.speaker: Oona
voice.text: Shh... I still sleep with a nightlight.
voice.caption: SHH... SECRET
voice.delivery: embarrassed confiding whisper, then a tiny giggle

sfx.desc: Crystal placed: a soft whoosh up into a bright glass chime (light flying into the lantern).
A new crystal wakes: rising magical shimmer, twinkly harp glissando, warm and gentle.
Generic SMUDGED! sting: playful cartoon boing / slide-whistle down (never a fail buzzer).
Gag 1: a tiny cute 'ah-ah-CHOO!' sneeze + a sprinkle twinkle.
Gag 2: a small cute 'hic-burp' + a soap-bubble pop.
Gag 3: a soft 'poof' + a hollow pumpkin 'bonk'.
SILVER MOON: a twinkly two-chord chime, bright and happy.
WITCH'S HAT: a magical swirl + sparkle arpeggio, a little mischievous.
WISHING STAR: harp glissando + a soft warm gong (the host's cue to come over). No harsh brass.
Each press/tap during charge: a tiny bright blip (it repeats fast).
The big plinth button when idle: a friendly bloop.
Charge meter full: a quick rising 'ding-ding-DING'.
Sleepy crystal: a soft descending double-bloop, gentle (never an error buzz).
Soft airy whoosh for transitions (goodbye float-up, star-wisp).
Smudge munching moon-crumbs: cute nom-nom crunches (attract loop).
Milestone: a party-horn toot + a cheer + sparkles, kid-friendly.
The Moon fills: a big warm magical swell into a happy chord.

music.desc: Seamless 45-90 s loop: gentle spooky-cute music-box / celesta lullaby with soft pizzicato, slow, cozy, never scary. Quiet enough to talk over.
The same lullaby in a brighter, happier arrangement for after the Moon is full.
